$comment: Single source of truth for model routing, shared by bin/opencode-sync and opencode/claudefiles.ts. tier_map values use OpenCode's `variant` key, NOT `effort` -- OpenCode's AgentConfig schema (https://opencode.ai/config.json) has no `effort` key and does not set `additionalProperties: false`, so an `effort` entry is accepted and silently discarded: every subagent then falls back to the OpenAI provider default of `reasoningEffort: "medium"` (transform.ts's gpt-5 branch). This script emitted `effort` until 2026-08-14; the tell was that every named subagent in opencode.db had an empty `variant` field while only the TUI-configured primary agent carried one. That is bug #514 -- do not reintroduce the `effort` key.
